About me
It started with "why" in childhood
It built a career later

Born in Bologna, Italy, in the late '80s, I've spent the past 14 years building an international career across Europe — at the crossroads of marcom, innovation and technology. Along the way, I've helped B2B and tech-focused organisations create and manage strategic content that attracts the right people, sparks the right conversations, and moves things forward.

With a career that started in SaaS and editorial content, and has since evolved into deep tech and quantum technology, I've worked both in-house and freelance at shiny new startups and bigger-sized organisations. I've simplified complex topics such as quantum technology, cryogenics and superconducting systems, written think pieces, featured articles and thought leadership interviews, and built social media, SEO and tone of voice strategies from the ground up.

In environments filled with complex jargon, I aim to create clarity — crafting content that resonates, tells a story, and is truly human. I've collaborated with international research institutions, founders, government bodies, policymakers and industry ecosystems to improve positioning, visibility and stakeholder alignment across Europe.

My favourite quote has always been:

"I have no special talents, I am only passionately curious." — Albert Einstein

I like to think I'm good at a few of the things I mentioned above, but without curiosity it's all pretty meaningless.

After more than a decade of professional adventures across Europe, Brussels has become my fifth home-away-from-home — the place where innovation, tech policy and strategy intersect in the most dynamic way.

How I Work
Assisted by AI.
Directed by me.

AI is here to stay — especially in a content strategy role, the question isn't whether to use it, it's knowing where you end and it begins. I use AI very actively: research, synthesis, structure, first drafts on repeatable formats. But the insight and the opinion? Those stay mine.

There's already too much boring, flat content filling the void without saying anything. I'm not here to feed that.

"In a world full of synthetics, I create content with a point of view. Work that builds recognition, earns trust and triggers curiosity. No fluff, no filler, no narratives that sound right and mean nothing."
AI handles
Research & synthesis
Structure & formatting
First drafts on repeatable formats
Speed on execution
I keep
The insight & the opinion
The story angle & voice
The human judgment
What's worth saying & why
